_about: What every CV in this folder should produce. Read by api/tests/test_expectations.py
(demo mode) and by scripts/run_cases.py (demo mode or Gemini).
must_have: skills that must be extracted. 'A|B' accepts either name.
must_not_have: skills that must never be extracted, in any mode.
model_must_not_have: traps the model must avoid. Demo mode matches words without
reading them, so these are only checked with Gemini.
gap: run the CV against postings from ../postings and check the Agent 3 groups.
Every name and detail in these CVs is fictional.

english_cv.about: Short English CV, one skills line.

arabic_cv.about: Arabic CV whose PDF stores each word's letters backwards.

backend_cv.about: Backend engineer, matched against an English backend posting.

graduate_cv.about: Fresh graduate: coursework skills and soft skills.

data_analyst_en.about: Printed by Chrome. Skills spread across experience, projects and a skills line.

career_changer_en.about: Printed by Chrome. An accountant moving into data: few technical skills.

traps_en.about: Printed by Chrome. Mentions tools the person does not have yet.

frontend_mixed.about: Printed by Chrome, right to left. Arabic and English in the same lines.

senior_arabic.about: Printed by Chrome, right to left, two pages. Arabic with English tool names.

scanned.about: An image with no text layer. Rejected, not read.
